args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (2): r05, r06, reason summary_outlier. In both runs the largest flank difference sits at 295 µm, against a batch median of 84 µm (z 6.78). Their width-free ratio is -0.035, against a median of 0.079 (z -5.28), and it is the only negative one. Their REGR peak z of 8.09 is only a 0.12 %/h difference on 53.16 %/h, so it was not counted.
Cleared (6): r01, r02, r03, r04, r07, r08. All final checks pass, and plane sections passes wherever it was run. Their summaries are close to the batch. The flank-difference z of 2.4 on r04 and r08 is moderate and the same in both runs.
What the flagged runs have in common: identical final measurements, both reported with the width-free ratio, and both registered on tissue from 400 px from the tip. Their centre REGR peak position and growth-zone length are normal, but the flank difference (the curvature-rate signal) peaks far from the tip and the width-free ratio is negative. The profile has a different shape. r04 used the same settings and looks normal, so the settings alone do not explain it. Rigid invariance on r05 and r06 is 1.695 %/h, the closest of any run to its 2.0 threshold.
